# State card

<!-- Generated by `node dev/docs.mjs markdown` from docs/catalog.mjs. Do not edit. -->

`custom:more-info-state-card` renders the top of a native more-info: the state header (state and last changed) and the big native control. `control: auto` picks the same control as Home Assistant; any other value forces one.

## Controls

Lights get the whole native light control: the brightness slider, the button bar (power, brightness, color, color temperature, white) and the favorite colors; on/off lights get the lightbulb toggle. Entities whose more-info is a view of its own (camera, conversation, counter, date, datetime, group, image, input_datetime, person, remote, sun, time, timer, update, weather) and those whose more-info is only the state row (number, select, text, scene and the `input_*` helpers) use `control: more_info`: the native more-info content itself, under the native state row where more-info shows one. The state header is then hidden by default (`show_state: true` adds it back). On a full-height sheet, the control sits in the free height like in more-info. Scripts, buttons and automations, which more-info only gives plain buttons, get `control: trigger`: a momentary switch with the shape, size and colors of the toggle. Tapping it sends the handle up in the state color, confirms with a check (or an error) and drops it back; a running script keeps it up and breathing, with Cancel below (`show_cancel: false` hides it). Automations run their actions (conditions skipped, like more-info) and get an on/off button below; scripts with fields show the native fields form, and the switch waits for the required ones. The header says when it last ran or was pressed. `control: script` and `control: press` keep the plain native buttons. `control: push` is the same action as one big stateless push button, lit only while the action happens (the press, a running script); `button_layout` shapes it: `vertical` (like the toggle, default), `horizontal`, `square` or `circle`. `icon` (and `icon_off` for the toggle) replace the entity icon of the toggle, trigger and push controls; `color` and `color_off` recolor the native control through the state color variables it reads, so they reach every control that uses the state color.

### toggle

Switches, input booleans, sirens. Lights without brightness use the lightbulb icons; sirens get the volume icons and, when they have tones, volume or duration, the native More controls dialog.

![toggle](images/state_toggle.png)

<sub>Shown inside a popup bound to `switch.decorative_lights`.</sub>

```yaml
type: custom:more-info-state-card
entity: switch.decorative_lights
```

### position

<sub>Shown inside a popup bound to `cover.hall_window`.</sub>


### lock

Lock toggle. Locks that open get the Open button (tap twice to confirm); a jammed lock shows its pulsing icon with Unlock / Lock. Codes are asked with the native code dialog unless the entity has a default code.

![lock](images/state_lock.png)

<sub>Shown inside a popup bound to `lock.front_door`.</sub>

```yaml
type: custom:more-info-state-card
entity: lock.front_door
```

### vacuum_status

Vacuum illustration (animated while cleaning), the command buttons (start / pause, stop, return home, locate, clean spot) and Cleaning by area, which opens the native view inside the popup. The header shows the status and the device battery. The fan speed is left to the controls card. Lawn mowers get start / pause, stop and dock.

![vacuum_status](images/state_vacuum.png)

<sub>Shown inside a popup bound to `vacuum.demo_vacuum_0_ground_floor`.</sub>

```yaml
type: custom:more-info-state-card
entity: vacuum.demo_vacuum_0_ground_floor
```

## Remote

Media players of the Apple TV integration get the remote of their device: a Now playing / Remote switch above the native media player control (`remote: auto`, the default; other media players are unchanged). The Remote view is a round clickpad and the buttons of the Siri Remote: back, TV, play / pause, volume and mute. The ring clicks the arrows (held, they repeat). The center works like the touch surface as far as the integration allows: it only takes key presses, so a drag sends one arrow every few millimeters, a fast flick adds a few more, and a finger that stays still after a drag keeps scrolling that way. A tap is select; a long press holds select (context menu). Holding TV opens Control Center. Commands go through `remote.send_command` one call at a time, merged with `num_repeats` when they come faster than the device answers, and repeats still waiting are dropped when the finger leaves, so the focus stops with it. Above the clickpad, what is playing and the power button; mute uses `media_player.volume_mute` and only shows when the media player supports it. Keys and gestures give haptic feedback in the companion apps (and vibrate on Android browsers); `haptics: false` turns it off. Arrow keys and Enter drive the focused clickpad.

### Media player with its remote

Nothing to configure for an Apple TV: the switch appears on its own. `remote_view: remote` opens on the remote, `remote: none` hides it, and `remote: remote.<id>` picks another remote entity.

```yaml
type: custom:more-info-state-card
entity: media_player.living_room_apple_tv
remote_view: remote
```

### Remote alone

`control: remote` shows only the remote, for the `remote.*` entity or a media player with one; the media player of the same device fills the Now playing strip.

```yaml
type: custom:more-info-state-card
entity: remote.living_room_apple_tv
control: remote
```

## Options

### Custom state text

`state_override` replaces the state text, and the button text of the trigger, push, press and script controls.

![Custom state text](images/state_override.png)

<sub>Shown inside a popup bound to `light.kitchen_lights`.</sub>

```yaml
type: custom:more-info-state-card
entity: light.kitchen_lights
state_override: "Cooking light"
```

### Without last changed

`show_last_changed: false` keeps only the state.

![Without last changed](images/state_no_time.png)

<sub>Shown inside a popup bound to `switch.ac`.</sub>

```yaml
type: custom:more-info-state-card
entity: switch.ac
show_last_changed: false
```

### Header only

`control: none`.

![Header only](images/state_header_only.png)

<sub>Shown inside a popup bound to `sensor.outside_temperature`.</sub>

```yaml
type: custom:more-info-state-card
entity: sensor.outside_temperature
control: none
```

### A different control

Force `toggle` on a dimmable light.

![A different control](images/state_force_toggle.png)

<sub>Shown inside a popup bound to `light.office_rgbw_lights`.</sub>

```yaml
type: custom:more-info-state-card
entity: light.office_rgbw_lights
control: toggle
```

### Control only

`show_state: false`.

![Control only](images/state_no_header.png)

<sub>Shown inside a popup bound to `light.bed_light`.</sub>

```yaml
type: custom:more-info-state-card
entity: light.bed_light
show_state: false
```

### Card appearance

`appearance: card` draws a regular card (default `plain` has no frame, like more-info).

![Card appearance](images/state_card.png)

<sub>Shown inside a popup bound to `fan.ceiling_fan`.</sub>

```yaml
type: custom:more-info-state-card
entity: fan.ceiling_fan
appearance: card
```
